import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Price distribution by sensor type
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Camera Price Distribution by Sensor Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Megapixels vs Price with brand differentiation
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
top_brands = df['brand'].value_counts().nlargest(5).index
df_top_brands = df[df['brand'].isin(top_brands)]
scatter = ax2.scatter(data=df_top_brands, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', 
                      c='model_year', cmap='viridis', alpha=0.7, s=50)
ax2.set_title('Megapixels vs Price (Top 5 Brands)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Model Year', fontsize=10)

# Add brand labels for some points
for brand in top_brands:
    brand_data = df_top_brands[df_top_brands['brand'] == brand]
    if len(brand_data) > 0:
        median_point = brand_data.iloc[len(brand_data)//2]
        ax2.annotate(brand, (median_point['megapixels'], median_point['price_usd']),
                    fontsize=8, alpha=0.8)

# 3. Weight distribution by body type
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='body_type', y='weight_grams', ax=ax3, inner='quartile')
ax3.set_title('Camera Weight Distribution by Body Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=12)
ax3.set_ylabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=12)
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. 4K Video capability by sensor type
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
video_counts = df.groupby(['sensor_type', 'has_video_4k']).size().unstack()
video_percentages = video_counts.div(video_counts.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100
video_percentages.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax4, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'])
ax4.set_title('4K Video Capability by Sensor Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=12)
ax4.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=12)
ax4.legend(['No 4K', 'Has 4K'], title='4K Video')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 5. Price trends over model years
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
yearly_stats = df.groupby('model_year').agg({
    'price_usd': ['mean', 'median', 'std'],
    'megapixels': 'mean'
}).round(2)

years = yearly_stats.index
price_mean = yearly_stats[('price_usd', 'mean')]
price_std = yearly_stats[('price_usd', 'std')]

ax5.plot(years, price_mean, marker='o', linewidth=2.5, label='Mean Price', color='#2E86AB')
ax5.fill_between(years, price_mean - price_std, price_mean + price_std, alpha=0.2, color='#2E86AB')
ax5.set_title('Camera Price Trends Over Model Years', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=12)
ax5.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12)
ax5.legend()
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Correlation heatmap of numerical features
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
numerical_cols = ['model_year', 'megapixels', 'max_iso', 'weight_grams', 'price_usd', 'has_video_4k']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, ax=ax6, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax6.set_title('Feature Correlation Heatmap', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
